priority: Local preferences apply only after explicit user intent and model-specific official rules.

preferences.instruction: Explicit current-request constraints override identity defaults, inferred clothing, and aesthetic completion. Preserve identity traits that do not conflict.
Artist strings are managed by the plugin and must not be generated, removed, or rewritten by the prompt planner.
When the user names a character but gives no environment, prefer a clean character-display composition with simple background or white background instead of inventing a complex location.
Adapt researched techniques and famous-scene visual language to the actual requested subject; do not add the source performer unless requested.
Treat NSFW as a compatibility alias for explicit content intent. Compile it into a supported rating directive and concrete requested visual terms instead of relying on the literal nsfw token.
